# GitHub Copilot Instructions for NVSentinel

The canonical agent instructions for this repository live in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repo root. Read that file.

Do not duplicate its content here — two copies drift, and a stale instruction file is worse than none.

Further reading, in the order an agent usually needs it:

- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) — commands, conventions, anti-patterns, what is out of scope for agents
- [DEVELOPMENT.md](../DEVELOPMENT.md) — full development guide, build system, debugging
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) — contribution workflow, review process, DCO
- [docs/](../docs/) — architecture and design documentation
